<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chatty Sheep 5</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by KhaledMatalkah - https://uiverse.io/KhaledMatalkah/chatty-sheep-5 */
/* From Uiverse.io by KhaledMatalkah - Tags: button, hover, ease */
.button {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 15px 30px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease-in, transform 0.3s ease;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.button:before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #76a6ca;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: width 0.7s ease-in-out, opacity 0.9s ease;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.button:hover:before {
  width: 100%;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.button:active {
  background-color: #76a6ca;
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  transform: scale(0.98);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Hover Me!
</button>
</body>
</html>
